messages:
olivia: Quick sync on NovaHealth renewal — they want split invoicing (Prod vs Sandbox), a single PO that references both invoices, prefer CC for the initial invoice to speed payment, and then PO for subsequent renewals. Also asking to move to net30 (we're on net45) and the SOW signature block uses the wrong legal entity. They want a 1-hr enablement session before renewal. Any blockers?

ethan: got it. do we have the committed seat count and renewal term? are they asking for 12mo?

nova_health_ops: Hi team — yes 12mo renewal, same seat count: 45 seats. Procurement will send PO but prefers we take CC for the first invoice to avoid delays.

sofia: We can do split invoices but need the billing name + VAT/Tax ID for each invoice. If the legal entity differs from billing entity we need a cross-ref. Also CC payments require tokenization; payments ops needs card details flow or hosted page. Gateway fee is 2.9% + $0.30 — should we absorb it?

devlin: on signatures — current SOW references "Redwood Inc." but Nova legal asked for "Redwood Inference, Inc." and full address block. I can draft a short amendment for sig block + update payment terms to net30. Are they fine with DocuSign?

olivia: they want DocuSign. Devlin, can you draft the amendment that covers entity name, net30, and the PO referencing both invoices? keep it minimal.

devlin: yes — I'll prepare a 1-page amendment and push by EOD. will keep standard warranty/limits intact.

sofia: Draft invoice lines for internal review:
```
INV-ITEMS:
  Prod_subscription: $14,000/mo
  Sandbox_compute: $1,250/mo
  Tax: TBD (need VAT ID)
  Total_monthly: $15,250
```
If they pay first invoice by CC, gateway fee would be ~$442 for that month. If AE wants to waive, finance needs explicit approval in CRM.

ethan: can we offer a one-time gateway fee waiver as a courtesy? thinking yes for strategic accounts. i'll ask my manager now.

sofia: I can absorb the fee on the first invoice if AE confirms in CRM. Otherwise we have to add it to invoice.

olivia: @ethan please confirm waiver by EOD. Lia — enablement? Nova requested week of May 15.

lia: I can do May 16 at 10am PT for a 60-min enablement. Need final SOW and a short list of top 3 use cases beforehand.

nova_health_ops: We'll send a PO draft this afternoon and the billing contact: finance@novahealth.co. We can accept DocuSign for the amendment.

billing-bot: Draft invoice INV-DRAFT-1991 created (prod/sandbox split). Preview: https://billing.internal/inv/INV-DRAFT-1991

olivia: summary / next steps: 1) Devlin -> amendment draft to correct sig block + net30 + PO reference (due EOD). 2) Sofia -> finalize invoices with VAT once Nova provides Tax IDs and produce final total including gateway if not waived. 3) Ethan -> confirm gateway fee waiver and update CRM. 4) Lia -> reserve May 16 enablement slot pending final SOW. 5) Nova -> send PO draft and billing contact. I'll follow up when amendment/invoice ready.

devlin: uploaded amendment draft to /legal/drafts/1991234567-amendment-nova.docx and shared with olivia + ethan. please review.

ethan: manager approved one-time gateway fee waiver. i'll add note in CRM and confirm here.

sofia: noted — i'll remove the gateway line from the first invoice and mark waived. need the billing VAT ID to calc taxes though.

nova_health_ops: sending PO draft + VAT ID for billing entity now. thanks all. :pray:
